You will join our AI Hub. The AI Hub drives the adoption of AI across BEC and helps transform the way software is developed, delivered and operated. We work closely with engineering teams, architects and technology partners to explore and apply emerging AI technologies where they create real business value.

The Senior AI Engineering Specialist role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of AI for software engineering within the financial technology industry. You will shape engineering best practices for AI software development, support AI utilization in financial products and help development teams successfully adopt new AI-powered ways of working potentially impacting +500 employees.

Your direct manager will be Henriette Jensen.

Primary task and responsibilities include:

  • Establish best practices for AI-assisted software development, including coding, testing and engineering workflows (~30%)
  • Develop prototypes, proofs of concept and provide as AI SME across several areas incl. financial services, software development and internal processes (~30%)
  • Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to engineering teams adopting AI (~30%)
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools and models relevant to software engineering (~10%)
  • Collaborate with architects, platform engineers, developers and external technology partners to identify opportunities for AI adoption
  • Join AI hub, a strategic centralized unit, that includes AI engineers, Legal SME and AI evangelist (supporting user adoption) located mostly in Warsaw. Only a few yearly trips to Denmark will be required
  • Share knowledge through training, demos, communities of practice and technical guidance

To succeed you will have: 

  • Extensive experience as a software engineer, software architect or similar senior technical role
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies, LLMs and AI-assisted software development
  • Experience using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI engineering platforms
  • Strong understanding of software engineering practices, SDLC and modern development workflows
  • Curiosity and passion for experimenting with emerging technologies and sharing knowledge with others
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • A proactive approach, solution and service-oriented mindset
  • A curious mind with an open nature and desire to knowledge-share with others

It’s nice-to-have:

  • Experience training, fine-tuning or evaluating AI models
  • Experience with AI harnesses, evaluation frameworks or benchmarking approaches
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI or Anthropic technologies
  • Experience with Python or Java
  • Knowledge of agentic AI systems and autonomous workflows
  • Experience working within highly regulated environments such as financial services
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI and emerging AI regulations

You will join our Payments domain, where we build and maintain critical components of the Danish and European payments infrastructure. 

We are currently working on initiatives such as SEPA Instant (EUR), STEP2, and other key payment transformations. Our systems handle high-volume, real-time payment processing and are critical to ensuring compliance and stability for our member banks. 

As a QA Automation Engineer, your primary focus will be to drive and expand test automation across complex payment solutions, covering backend services, APIs, messaging flows, and user interfaces. 

You will be part of a cross-site team based in Denmark and Poland, working closely with developers and analysts to ensure high quality across the full delivery lifecycle. 

Your direct manager will be Sanne Sommer Lyster.

Primary tasks and responsibilities 

  • Test automation ownership: Drive the test automation agenda in the team and help increase automation coverage across systems. 
  • Automation development: Design, implement, and maintain automated tests across APIs, backend services (Java), and UI (Angular). 
  • End-to-end testing: Ensure quality across complex, distributed payment flows, including real-time and batch processing. 
  • Message-based testing: Validate ISO 20022 payment messages and flows across MQ-based integrations. 
  • Quality advocacy: Promote quality best practices and help the team adopt a strong QA and automation mindset. 
  • Collaboration: Work closely with developers to integrate testing into the development process and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Defect analysis: Investigate defects using logs, data, and system insights to identify root causes. 
  • Continuous improvement: Improve frameworks, tooling, and ways of working within test and automation. 

To succeed in this role, you will have 

  • Strong experience with test automation in modern systems. 
  • Experience testing APIs and backend services (for example REST and messaging systems). 
  • Experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, REST Assured, or similar. 
  • ISTQB Foundation certification, or similar. 
  • Experience testing web applications, preferably Angular-based user interfaces. 
  • Knowledge of MQ (for example IBM MQ) and message-based integrations. 
  • Ability to validate XML/JSON and schemas (XSD/JSON Schema). 
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot using logs and system data. 
  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to work across roles such as development, QA, and business analysis. 
  • A structured, proactive, and quality-driven mindset. 
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience with payments such as SEPA, Instant Payments, STEP2, and ISO 20022. 
  • Understanding of real-time systems and high-availability architectures. 
  • Experience with z/OS, DB2, or other mainframe technologies. 
  • Programming skills in Java and/or TypeScript.
